plugins.name: offline-office-docs
plugins.description: Offline office document toolkit for Windows intranet: read/edit Word/Excel/PPT OOXML packages, extract/merge/split/create PDFs with a pure-PowerShell engine, and convert via installed MS Office/WPS. No internet, no npm, no Python.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Windows 内网离线环境办公文档工具：纯 PowerShell 直接读写 Word/Excel/PPT（OOXML），内置 PDF 引擎（提取/合并/拆分/旋转/生成），装有 Office/WPS 时可互转 PDF。无需外网、npm 或 Python。
